heading: Ishan is the 'chosen one'? Mayawati's latest U-turn deepens ongoing BSP family drama
author: Times of India Editorial
paragraphs: In a strategic move, Mayawati has selected Ishan Anand for an important party role, succeeding his brother Akash Anand who was recently ousted. Akash's conduct and the potential influence of his father-in-law were cited as reasons for this decision. Mayawati highlights the necessity of integrity and commitment for Ishan as he embarks on this new chapter in the BSP.
